messages.subject: Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear James,

Your executive-search and board advisory work across energy, infrastructure, government and sustainability aligns closely with my background in regulated, asset-intensive environments. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across mining, energy and infrastructure where institutional trust, regulation and responsible growth are strategic priorities. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
